'''Trading''' in [[Pet Simulator 99]] is a feature that allows players to trade pets, items, enchants, potions, hoverboards, booths and diamonds.

The player can open the Trading menu by clicking the Inventory menu and clicking on the green and yellow button. On the trading menu, will be show a players list. You can only trade players with trade enabled. When a player sends a trade to you, a pop-up on appears on top of your screen, which you accept or not accept the trade. You can trade how many diamonds and pets you want. You can enable, disable, or set as only friends to trade with you in the settings.

'''Note: Some items are untradable, which cannot be traded.'''
